A neighborhood garden can significantly reduce water use through mulching, which helps retain soil moisture and suppresses weeds. Collecting rainwater in barrels for irrigation is another effective method. Drip irrigation delivers water directly to plant roots, minimizing evaporation and runoff. Watering early in the morning, when temperatures are cooler, ensures that plants absorb the water efficiently before the heat of the day causes excessive evaporation.
